name: Pearl
source:
One of the three fairy kings in the Marine Forest Kingdom. Sea fairy king.

Always grumpy and unfriendly. There's something she doesn't like, and she hates Tiararose.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3042660/The_Villainess_Is_Adored_by_the_Prince_of_the_Neighbor_Kingdom/]Steam[/url]]
